# About
Coach Subham is the professional brand of Subham Shaw, a National Level Boxer and certified Fitness Coach based in Bangalore, India.

# Services
- Fitness Boxing: High-intensity boxing-based workouts for cardio, fat loss, and mental discipline. Available online and in-person in Bangalore.
- Fat Loss Program: Scientific, structured fat loss programs that burn stubborn fat using HIIT, nutrition guidance, and lifestyle optimization. Results visible in 8 weeks.
- Strength Training: Progressive overload-based strength programs that build real, functional muscle and power.
